title: Q-SAYDO-rules-DECISIONS-1: says DECISIONS-1, does not do it
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** say-do check (SAY-DO-1) on the watchdog run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation saydo --probe rules:DECISIONS-1
**Status:** open

The system states `DECISIONS-1` (rules) and its code does not do it: python3 -m foundation decisions --check: seed/worker/src/planner.js: has a decision-shaped function with no declared metric; add `DECISION-METRIC: <point>` (and register the point) or, if it is not a decision, list it with a reason

Change the code to do what the statement says, or change the statement to what the code does; never weaken the probe.

size: S

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation saydo --probe rules:DECISIONS-1` exits 0.
